commit.message:
Document private= and bucket_id= in trackio examples; fix stale Jobs sync description (#185)

* docs: document private= / bucket_id= in trackio examples; update stale Jobs sync description

Agents following the trackio examples create public Spaces by default
(examples show space_id= but never private=). Document private and
bucket_id in the huggingface-trackio skill and the llm-trainer trackio
guide, framing private=True as a choice (omit for a shareable public
dashboard).

Also update the llm-trainer guide's 'How It Works with Jobs' section,
which described the old Dataset/Parquet 5-minute sync: current trackio
streams to the running Space (batched sub-second), spills to an HF
Bucket every ~30s when the Space is unreachable/building, and the Space
ingests the bucket inbox every ~15s (verified against trackio main:
run.py BATCH_SEND_INTERVAL/BUCKET_FLUSH_INTERVAL, utils.get_inbox_poll_interval).
